title: Raku Experience
evidence_sentence: This workshop provides a hands-on taster experience with Raku firing, where participants glaze and fire up to 3 pieces.
evidence_quote: This workshop provides a wonderful opportunity for a hands-on taster experience with Raku firing.
summary: Join a Raku workshop where you glaze and fire up to 3 pieces in a gas-fired kiln, with pieces reaching 1000°C and placed in organic matter for vibrant color effects. Beginners to experienced potters welcome; bring bisqueware or purchase pre-made pots.
bring: 3 pieces of bisqueware (max 12cm diameter, 20cm height) or purchase available pots at £5-£8
